notes.title: Version 1.020 update
notes.content: [p]A new update to the game after over a month of release. This update is a small head start to the major update that is to come sometime in the future. As I continue to progress with online match play and further improvements to the game, I wanted to provide some quick fixes to some issues I have noticed and wanted to addressed. Here are the following changes.[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]v1.020[/b][/p][p][/p][h3]Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Daiyousei no longer reverts to default color if using her desperation in alternate color.[/p][/*][*][p]Nitori no longer enters opponent's side when using a bomb.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Campaign[/h3][list][*][p]Set starting points to 10.[/p][/*][*][p]When picking Marisa, you no longer play as Reimu during the first match against Sakuya + Remilia.[/p][/*][*][p]Opponent wagers can now go up to 9.[/p][/*][*][p]Loser's bracket now only requires you to defeat 3 opponents.[/p][/*][*][p]During the final boss, projectile power up now adds to the reserves.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Gameplay[/h3][list][*][p]Lily now delivers ball to the left side in tutorial rather than center.[/p][/*][*][p]Shop prices lowered by around 20 - 30 percent from previous version's price.[/p][/*][*][p]Gem values have been increased with some having a value of 10 up to a maximum of 50.[/p][/*][*][p]When you have less than 15 points, opponents are much easier.[/p][/*][*][p]Upper spike has been altered when on top of the screen. Now your ball will actually go down instead.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Character Stats[/h3][list][*][p]Yuugi's upper spike has been decreased.[/p][/*][*][p]Youmu's desperation now has a taller hitbox.[/p][/*][*][p]Youmu's Bomb black out graphic has been slowed down.[/p][/*][*][p]Youmu's fully charged blade can now split into smaller blades when ball touches it.[/p][/*][*][p]Nitori's bomb now has variables to it. You must now collect opponent projectiles in order to get the maximum amount of bubbles to disperse.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]General[/h3][list][*][p]Added new color palettes. Access the third color by pressing the bomb button in character select.[/p][/*][*][p]Smaller micro updates and typo fixes.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]I also want to go over into detail a few of these changes.[/p][p][/p][p][i][b]Opponent wagers can now go up to 9[/b][/i][/p][p]During the campaign, every once in a while, you may get a challenge that is worth more than a single point. Originally, this only went up to 5, with the higher number being more uncommon. To alleviate the grind of having to reach 100 points, I have now increased the wagers up to 9. The higher numbers are still uncommon, but you should now be able to get higher wagers.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45438903/0fd4dd08c10dc1fef333b7180110322fafc60a56.png"][/img][/p][p][i][b]Loser's bracket now only requires you to defeat 3 opponents[/b][/i][/p][p]Before, you had to climb out of loser's bracket with -10 points. This turned out to be a challenge for most players, and they sunk deeper into negative points. This has been altered to only give you -3 points and any loses leads to an immediate game over. But your progressed is saved, so now you only need to defeat 3 opponents before restarting the tournament with 10 points.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45438903/f36e90a6712b7c61aea99bf7879cc0e43398487d.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i][b]Upper spike has been altered when on top of the screen. Now your ball will actually go down instead[/b][/i][/p][p]There was an oversight where some characters could go to the top of the screen, use the upper spike to bypass the opponent and hit the wall. This lead to easy victories as the opponent could not do anything. This was perfectly displayed by Yuugi who could get the ball to a very high altitude with a high speed and she having the highest power stat would lead to easy victories every time. This has been addressed by having a normal spike no longer elevate, and high spikes actually now drop the ball. Interesting note about this, I was originally going to implement this early on in the game's development, but I never got around to actually adding it and simply thought it was not necessary. I wasn't anticipating the issue, but perhaps in the back of my mind, this was perhaps the reason why I thought of this in the first place. But this is still a new concept to add to the game and will surely change how it plays, so do leave a comment on what you think of this new implementation.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45438903/12f382de881282193ef1291be1dc4dad90b7a495.png"][/img][/p][p][i][b]Added new color palettes. Access the third color by pressing the bomb button in character select.[/b][/i][/p][p]Self explanatory, but I wanted to make a note of it since it may not be so obvious. In a future update of the game, I will add a separate menu to select a color palette rather than have button presses. Also here's a little tip. Select Random and press either the projectile or bomb button. Now you can preview the alternative color without having to select the character first.[/p]

notes.title: Version 1.014
notes.content:
Various additions and changes to version 1.014

[list]
[*] No Partner option in Round 2 has been disabled to keep the game from causing errors.
[*] New dialogue after purchasing the wallet to instruct you on how items work.
[*] Wallet price dropped to 400.
[*] Discount event happens more frequently.
[*] Sakuya cheating penalty reduced to 10 points.
[*] Some characters have been buffed upon reaching the final boss.
[*] Fixed the issue where the Partner Orders would not save.
[*] Fixed issue where depleting Sakuya's health during her Desperation doesn’t cancel the time slowdown.
[*] Sakuya slow down consumes twice the desperation.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.013
notes.content:
The changes for this version:

[list]
[*] Game no longer soft-locks during tutorial.
[*] Campaign pause menu added.
[*] Altered CPU opponent slightly.
[*] Shop discount now appears more frequently.
[*] Suika has been nerfed.
[/list]

For those suggesting changes to the CPU AI, I am taking your suggestions but please be patient. This CPU opponents require a lot of testing due to needing to accommodate all characters match ups. But by all means, continue to send feedback and suggestions.

notes.title: Version 1.012, you can now pause during a match in campaign
notes.content:
Further changes and fixes.

[list]
[*] Removed flicker when selecting an opponent on the overworld.
[*] Added thunder sound to lightning weather event.
[*] You can now pause during the campaign match.
[*] The store can randomly have a sale with items at reduced price.
[*] Weather report now posted in overworld overlay.
[*] Items and weather events are now saved so you they can resume when you leave campaign mode.
[*] Increased gauntlet rewards.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.011
notes.content:
A small update with some more fixes.

- Weather event cutscenes have been fixed.
- Bombs that would crash the game when used on Youmu's blades has been fixed.
- Fixed issue with computer opponent always hanging at the center edge, bouncing ball infinitely.
- Fixed opponent always shooting in tutorial even if you set their shoot frequency to never.

notes.title: Fixed Chen dialogue bug
notes.content:
A bug was discovered when Chen's dialogue appears in the overworld that would soft lock the game. This has been fixed.

- Fixed Chen dialogue bug.
- Fixed issue where wager matches would not happen.
- Weather events can happen more frequently.

notes.title: Version 1.009, Steam Input issue should be fixed
notes.content:
Here are the changes for version 1.009

[list]
[*] Button Config menu has been fixed. You can no longer press the same button twice and may reset your buttons in the middle of remapping.
[*] Song added for the sky stage.
[*] Survival bug fixed.
[*] Fixed Remilia's bomb crashing the game when used against Youmu.
[*] Fixed Youmu's projectile just standing still if she shoots it near the ball.
[*] Configured game loading, which should fix the Steam Input issue.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.008
notes.content:
Here are the changes for this version:

[list]
[*] Reimu's Bomb bug has been addressed.
[*] Dynamic difficulty has been altered. Opponents should now be getting more points, denoting harder difficulty.
[*] Opponents may now increase their wager.
[*] Lowered wallet price to 500 crystals.
[*] Made mini games and weather events appear more frequently.
[*] Dialogue has been added to opponents to denote difficulty. I also gave Hatate more funny lines.
[/list]

That should be it for the majority of the to-do list. There may till be more micro-updates in the near future. In any case, continue with the suggestions, any issues you find, or just anything cool you want me to add, and I'll add it to the to-do list for a later update.

notes.title: Version 1.006 update
notes.content:
Changes to v 1.006

[list]
[*] Sakuya bomb error addressed
[*] Cirno's desperation effect no longer makes annoying noise when picking up an item
[*] Added Cirno's sound effects to her bomb
[*] Opponent menu option in Training changed to allow use of arrow keys to change parameters
[*] Campaign menu added

notes.title: Version 1.004 update
notes.content:
The following updates were made

- Added stat information about each character in the campaign mode's character select
- Music added in another cutscene without it

notes.title: What to expect in the full release
notes.content:
Development on the game continues. After the demo was released, no time was spared in its continuation. In fact, there's actually less time now than expected. This game has been in development for over a year but without much of a release date in the future and it all sounded like everything was on track. But life sometimes throws you a curveball, forcing you to change plans. In this case, the game will now be coming out this summer so there's no time to waste. However, at the moment, I am thinking of what my next move will be. I just finished a task that took me two weeks to complete and now I need time to think of what I'm going to be doing for the next few months. So I figured while I figure this out, I'll update you guys on what I am planning for the full release of the game.

But before we move on to the development of the game, I want to talk about the demo that I released two weeks ago. I can't believe that it's already been two weeks since the release of the demo because it feels like I spent an eternity to get to this point. And yet, even after a year of planning and development, one can't foresee all issues that may arise. It appears that people have experienced some bugs and mishaps that slipped in such as menus not working and controller issues. This is in part because of the time crunch I had and all that was done in a month.

But at least I am relieved that all these bugs were only in the menus because the gameplay was enjoyed by everyone. Aside from some adjustments that I made such as increasing the cost of Sakuya's projectiles, there didn't seem to be anything wrong with the gameplay, which makes me very happy to hear.

But this is only the beginning as this teaser does not truly represent what the final product will be. For as much as I spent an entire year to get to this point, it was mainly for the gameplay, setting up the rules, preparing the character template to include a bigger roster, items, game controller support, pretty much everything that happens after you select a character. Everything else outside of that, like the menus, was done in around a month before the release of the teaser demo. But now that I have the gameplay set, I feel like I can now concentrate more on the quality-of-life aspects of the game. So don't get too used to the teaser demo because everything is going to be overhauled to feel more polished. And these changes will apply to all aspects of the game including, but not limited to the following.

[strike]_________________________________________[/strike]

[h1]Characters[/h1]

This may be the least changed from the teaser demo as the characters you have played will pretty much function the same. Minor adjustments will be made so they may feel a bit different later one, but all the same, it should be no different. What will be different is that there will be a bigger roster, which I will reveal right now. With the addition of the four already playable, the game will include the following character teams:

-  Cirno and Daiyousei
- Youmu Konpaku and Alice Margatroid
- Aya Shameimaru and Nitori Kawashiro
- Yuugi Hoshiguma and Suika Ibuki
- Ran Yakumo and Chen

[h1]Controllers[/h1]

Controller support will be overhauled. The current controller support either has you using the keyboard or the gamepad. This has caused many issues, especially when editing button mapping. That is why the future release will do away with this and simply have you use both keyboard and gamepad. This will require an overhaul of the current controller setting so I won't be able to update the teaser demo for this. I apologize for this inconvenience but from here on, I will be putting consideration for both control types.

[h1]Better Interface Design[/h1]

Though it may not seem like much, something players simply take for granted, but part of quality-of-life improvements does include these little things. The font, the menu design, and even the sound effects. All these things are aspects I never really considered until after the demo was released. For example, the font used was something I never considered until I realized that I was going to translate this game into two languages. It was then that I realized that font that I chose for basic text was unsuitable for Spanish and Japanese. I will now be making plans to make the game easier to navigate and much more pleasant to look at to avoid the inconveniences that arouse in the demo.

[h1]Better Music[/h1]

I know some people didn't mind the background music, but I left that music as a final task and didn't have time to experiment with it. It was really just shoved out as fast as possible due to time constraints. I am very dissatisfied with how the music came out. Improving the music is now on my to-do list. 

[strike]_________________________________________[/strike]

There's plenty more to consider but these are just the bigger things I want to address. I want to thank all players who have played the game and provided both error reports and suggestions. I read all and make note of them. Though I'm sure by now you have played all that the teaser has to offer, but I still need more players to check it out. That is why I urge you that if you see the potential this game has, please share the game on social media and let others know about it. This game is planning to be bigger than what you see but I can't do it alone. All your help is greatly appreciated.

Thank you.

notes.title: What is the teaser demo?
notes.content:
After a little over a year of development, I have finally released the first demo of the volleyball game, the teaser demo. But what is a teaser demo? It is a demo that showcases the fundamentals of the game rather while still representing what the final game could be like.

But another reason for this teaser demo is to get feedback before I go really deep into the game. If I offered a more robust demo, it may have been more difficult to make changes to it later on. The Teaser Demo is a smaller version of what I intend to offer in the final game. This way, if there are changes needed, I can do so relatively quickly as I build the game. That is why its very important to let me know what you think about the game on the Steam forums so that changes and improvements can be made.

What to expect from this Teaser Demo:

- Four characters available: Reimu, Marisa, Sakuya, and Remilia.
- A single demo of the main gameplay as well as a training room.
- Supports up to 4 human players.
- A preview of the partner AI system, where you can choose a set number of commands to your CPU partner.
- Keyboard and controller support, but gamepad is recommended.

So go ahead and download the demo and let me know what you think on the Steam forums.
